content_of_post_to_comment:
Up until recently i think I've been dreaming too small.

I've just been thinking i want to bring into existence, an ideal life for me and my boyfriend, and the thought of that becoming a reality sounds like a dream come true. He means everything to me and i want him to have everything good in this life.

I would of course manifest things for myself, not just him.

But it's always been a strong desire of mine to help other people. Also, he and i have similar dreams and aspirations, so it would be good for me as well.

I don't know if i will tell him or just watch his responses and enjoy his happiness. I might tell him after I've manifested everything he and i wanted in life. Or maybe i won't. I'll cross that bridge when i come to it.

And i don't mean a bunch of possessions. I want us to travel the world, go to conventions and ren faires, and have the money to just help people in need wherever we go. Just, giving a waitress plenty of money to pay off any debts she has, or to buy a home for someone without. Or to pay for low income housing to be built. Or to pay a large sum of money to a charity i trust, one that's actually helping people.

I was wondering whether anyone else has brought into existence things to help people they care about. If anything is possible i want to do more than just help myself. I don't want praise or rewards for helping people I care about. I just want the people i love to be happy and have all they need.

Please don't take this post as me trying to virtue signal or think I'm better than anyone. I know everyone has their own goals. And some of my desires are just for me and surface level. Like improving my appearance and fixing my eyesight. But im just wondering if anyone has used subliminals to help a friend or loved one. Please don't take this post the wrong way.
comment: I like that your vision of an ideal life isn't centered around collecting things, but around having the freedom to be generous. One thing I've noticed is that sometimes the desire to help others becomes even more powerful when paired with small actions now, not just a future where everything is perfect. You can start creating that version of yourself before the big manifestations happen.
